description: Judge whether a specific asking price for a PC part is good, by comparing it against tracked market data. Use when someone asks 'is $X a good price for Y' or wants a listing or sale price sanity-checked. Strongest for RAM (per-GB against the daily index) and for the parts tracked by component_price_index (RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, RTX 5070, RX 9070, Ryzen 5 9600X, Ryzen 7 9800X3D, 1TB/2TB NVMe), which are judged against today's floor AND months of daily history. Other parts fall back to matching deal headlines and say so. Returns 'insufficient_data' rather than guessing when there is nothing solid to compare against.

description.description: The part, as specifically as possible, e.g. '32GB DDR5-6000 (2x16)' or 'RTX 5070 Ti'.

name: price_check
